Actual fake-Drive authorized discover/select/preview commit callback now receives the same RestoreOperation, preserving a local edit when cancelled at FILES_READY and completing source data when cancellation loses after POINTER_COMMITTED; existing account/key/revision/session/expiry guards also pass.

scenarioEvidence.stale_incarnation: same test: previous state digest rejected with current revision after replacement
scenarioEvidence.candidate_tamper: RestoreCancellationDeviceTest.candidateTamperBeforePointerKeepsPreviousLedger: corrupt staged candidate rows at ROWS_READY; final authenticated read rejects before publication, old ledger/revision retained
scenarioEvidence.crash_before_publish: Pre-publication checkpoint failure covered; actual process termination during preparation not executed

scenarioEvidence.crash_after_publish_invalid: pendingPublicationReopensAndInvalidPendingRollsBackOnlyRecordedPredecessor: tamper while pending, rollback then old snapshot/revision/incarnation; same process
scenarioEvidence.crash_after_verified: migratesAllLegacyDomainsAndReopensDetachedReceipts: successful finalized migration reopened in new store instance; no additional fresh-process finalized transition
scenarioEvidence.established_corruption: same pending/established test locks repeatedly; missing both markers regression preserves rows
scenarioEvidence.pinned_previous: Read/install are serialized by database lease through Snapshot hydration; atomic checkpoint second-connection test passes. Independent long-lived exporter/file lease is not exposed/tested
scenarioEvidence.foreign_cleanup: 7 foundation groups preserve foreign/collision/replacement paths; new catalog GC foreign-entry injection not separately executed
scenarioEvidence.legacy_migration: Shared all-domain schema3 and old direct-Keystore 2MiB receipt migration; schema2 finance migration regression

publicationLinearization: One-shot admission suppresses duplicate Replace. CAS preparing->publishing inside pointer transaction after authenticated candidate read, immediately before setState; Cancel wins before CAS. No cancellation checks after successful pointer publication. ViewModel finally settles token and consumes preview on success/failure; post-publication exceptions use neutral verification guidance, never an assertion that the old vault was kept.

historicalBeforeCancellation.scope: Local schema4 integration at existing capacity, unchanged portable v1-v3; focused local evidence, not completed lifecycle/release/performance gate
sourceLimits: Current Snapshot hydration retains base64 allocations.
all/finance/attachments/vaultId hydrate complete snapshot; revision reads metadata.
Each receipt is verified during durable reopen then read again; mutation repeats old-row read and post-write full validation. No performance improvement claimed.
GC deletes authenticated complete unreferenced groups and preserves ambiguous/partial/foreign entries; physical staging-space retention is not comprehensively bounded.
No portable v4 integration. No real disk-full, power-loss, kill-during-syscall or signed-release proof.
